status_label: No paperwork supports a no-laundry claim
claim_assessment: No publicly available paperwork was located that establishes an absence of laundry facilities at this camp.
official_rule_finding: Illinois Migrant Labor Camp Code Section 935.65(d) requires laundry facilities supplied with hot and cold water for all occupants.
eta_790a_finding: The linked operator's ETA-790A job-order housing data does not address whether laundry facilities are present.
public_listing_finding: A current lodging listing for the linked operator's separate Morton housing property displays a laundry room; this is third-party counterevidence, not an IDPH inspection finding.
inspection_record_status: FOIA needed: inspection and correction records not publicly located
research_note: The public state roster is a licensing record, not an inspection report. Verify actual compliance through IDPH inspection, deficiency, correction, reinspection, and complaint records.
